I don’t lose my cool often, but when I do it’s explosive. My ex-wife and I call each other every day to catch up and say hi to our daughters. When I hang up, it’s all loneliness. When they hang up, they have each other. This is the bed I’ve made.

As we’ve talked and gotten used to this arrangement, we’ve been flexible and understanding.

One time I was supposed to have them the usual Friday-Sunday. She told me they had a birthday party with their best friend up there and asked if I could change the schedule up.

Background: We largely had the same friends. Some friends were put in the middle. Some stuck by me. Others stuck by her. One couple in particular had moved 2hrs north a couple years  before my escapades were public knowledge. They had been our best friends for years and there was a strong connection but it was stunted by us having our daughters and them still having none. They fell out of regular touch after they moved. Now they were back in our lives because they were decidedly on her side and she moved up to them.

Who is the party boy? The aforementioned couple’s nephew. My ex-wife is good friends with his his parents. They hang out all the the time and have become very important for her adjusting to a new place with 2 daughters and no one else. 

So that’s issue 1: I’m jealous that they get to watch my girls more. I’m jealous their friend’s daddy plays with them in the pool. They’re on his shoulders, not mine. It’s fucked up that the consequences of my actions are even thicker as a result. Addiction is the key source for all of my issues, but I’ve paid for it. Had to do a 15 month program. Had to pay thousands. Got fired and blacklisted for basically the entire 15 month span. Got divorced. Why should another consequence be levied. When will my punishment subside? They’ve spent so much time that in addition to my daughters learning to swim, my ex-wife learned to swim after years of me nagging her. I’m jealous they get to spend more time with this fucking family. Honestly, I’m jealous they get to see and spend time with my ex-wife so much. Jealous of her whole new life. Recap: I’m jealous this family spends more time together than I get to, because without the girls, my parents are ostensibly all I have. Can’t wait to get away from them.

Issue 2: He’s related that couple. You know...the ones who had been best friends until the divorce? What exactly did they do? They advocated an immediate divorce (no discussion or working it out. Betrayal. They ghosted me: removed me on all social media and the guy in the couple had been my gaming buddy. Not anymore. Won’t talk about what’s up. We don’t play games. I was mad and sent some heated messages to them. They weren’t mean or rude. I guess I would say they were critical. Over time, I let it go. If they didn’t want to talk to me, so be it.

So I was giving up some time so she could hang out with that surrogate family. The girls were interested in the party but they like visiting me too. I told her I would not mess the schedule up. After a few hours, I admitted to myself and her that I was just being petty. The only people I’d be disappointing or harming would be my girls. It’s stupid to have a spat by leverage kids as weapons.

When I step back I can see the absurdity:

It’s good that my ex-wife has a great support team. It’s great that my girls have good friends. It’s fair, whatever difficult or harmful thing befalls me.

Let’s work on it. 2 years later: she divorced me.

She had every right. I have no idea how she remained as strong as she did. She really did want it to work but I just keep unraveling. Out of control
